plotSections.title: Deciding Where to Search for Grixto
bullets: Walker considers returning to The Reach with Elrus to investigate the vision showing Grixto and Galixtar near the training grounds, while the rest of the party could return to Langdale for information.

The group concludes that the old roost in The Reach has probably been uninhabited for a long time, and Grixto could have moved elsewhere after gaining the ability to travel through arches. Walker agrees that finding him there is unlikely, but wants to exhaust the lead.
Sylan argues that a scouting mission is safer than a full confrontation and wants any eventual fight with Grixto to happen when the entire party is together.

plotSections.title: The Al Kurin and the Training Grounds
bullets: The group clarifies that Grixto had been collecting Al Kurin from the other trainees at the training grounds, including juvenile dragons.
The Al Kurin are vessels capable of containing the soul of a dragon and can be transported elsewhere, meaning the collected vessels do not necessarily remain at the training grounds.
The training grounds are within a couple of days' flight of Walker's former residence in The Reach, making it difficult to believe Grixto would remain there unnoticed for an extended period.

plotSections.title: Investigating the Lich and His Phylactery
bullets: The party remains uncertain about Grixto's current location and his phylactery despite having learned more about him.

The party believes Grixto's phylactery is a mundane object that he keeps on his person. They have repeatedly noticed him carrying or displaying small chess-like or war-game pieces, leading Sylan to speculate that the phylactery could be part of a chess set.

The party discusses their existing lore on phylacteries and confirms that one is a vessel containing a lich's soul, though the available lore does not explain the precise mechanics of how the lich returns after being destroyed.

plotSections.title: The Keystone and the Scouting Mission
bullets: Walker wants to visit The Reach partly because he can recharge his gems there. Sylan supports the trip as long as Walker treats it strictly as a scouting mission.
Sylan suggests Walker leave his keystone with the rest of the party for safety, but Walker insists on retaining it, noting that he has held onto the party's keystones in previous situations.
The party discusses the danger of concentrating multiple keystones in one Bag of Holding, since doing so could make the bag an especially valuable target.
Walker plans to take Elrus and Araden, giving the scouting group access to two dragons. The party also notes that Araden is highly skilled in magic.

chronologicalEvents: Walker tells Elrus that the party may return to The Reach and asks whether he wants to accompany them or remain in Midgard.
The party discusses hunting down Grixto and Galixtar, following a vision of them near the training grounds in The Reach.
Walker explains that the old roost in The Reach appears largely abandoned and that he has already searched there without finding anything.
The party considers sending Walker and a companion on a scouting mission while the others return to Langdale to question people who may know more about The Reach.
Sylan asks about the Al Kurin seen in the vision; the DM explains that Grixto had collected Al Kurin from other trainees, including juvenile dragons, and that the vessels can transport dragon souls.

The party decides the training grounds are unlikely to be Grixto's current hiding place because the Al Kurin could have been moved and the area is close enough to Walker's former residence that Grixto would have been difficult to conceal there.
The party discusses Grixto's phylactery and confirms that it is believed to be a mundane object kept on his person; Sylan notes his recurring chess-like pieces as a possible clue.
Walker and Sylan agree that The Reach is worth investigating before abandoning the lead, but Walker should avoid engaging Grixto unless necessary.
Walker explains that he wants to keep Araden and Elrus's capabilities hidden from Grixto so they can serve as a secret weapon in a future decisive confrontation.
Walker plans to travel to The Reach with Elrus and Araden, while the rest of the party can continue gathering information elsewhere.
